name: @pramaan/api

scripts.test:tz: for tz in Asia/Kolkata UTC America/New_York; do echo "-- TZ=$tz"; TZ=$tz node --test test/*.test.js || exit 1; done
scripts.d1:tz: for tz in Asia/Kolkata UTC America/New_York; do TZ=$tz node tools/d1-byte-fidelity.mjs || exit 1; done

devDependenciesReason: mysql2 is NOT a runtime dependency. Nothing under src/ imports it — the only importers are the legacy MySQL set (src/db.js, src/db/migrate.js) and the one-time export tool (tools/migrate-to-mongo.mjs), none of which the server ever loads. It stays only so `npm run migrate:to-mongo` can still read the old database. Delete it together with those three files once the MySQL data is confirmed unneeded.
